column3: errors: none (a real browser made a room from the running server; a second joined a made-up host's room over the Wi-Fi address and was sent into the race; not checked: a phone, another PC, a tunnel)

column2: Esc opens a menu (go on, start again, sound, leave to the main menu and out of the room), with a menu button on screen; the main menu is simpler: the name in a box at the top, four big buttons, and a room asks for the name first; the keys moved to the Esc menu and the first seconds of a climb; start-room.bat starts the room server by double-click
column3: errors: none (a scripted run typed a name, climbed, opened the Esc menu, left to the main menu, started a bot race and opened the menu again; not checked in a run: leaving a real room from the Esc menu, and the name being asked before a room, which need the server)

column2: English beside Kurdish, picked on the menu (or L); a controller plays it (standard pad mapping, PS5 and Xbox); the mouse shoves and fires on left click and grabs on right click; phone buttons bigger, shown only where they apply, with a cooldown ring and a short buzz; a room link (?room=CODE) that joins straight in after asking the name; the name and code screens open the phone's keyboard on a tap; the room's settings change by tap
column3: errors: none (a scripted run switched language twice, climbed, used the Esc menu and ran a bot race; not checked: a real controller, a real phone, the mouse buttons in a race, the room link, which need hardware or the server)
